A Junior PPC campaign manager
StoreYa offers a suite of marketing and advertising apps that helps 500,000 SMBs from 186 countries to increase sales, leads, and social following. We're looking these days to add another Google Ads Account Manager to join our amazing team!
Join us at StoreYa.com

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with clients to meet the goals of their Google & Facebook ad campaigns, including Customer Success and Retention Calls
  • Set up new campaigns and scale up existing ones
  • Daily optimization and management of the accounts
  • Characterize recommendations for improving and automating our in-house technology supporting the Facebook ads setup and optimization

Requirements

  • Native English speaker with strong written and verbal skills
  • 1 year of hands-on experience managing Google and Facebook ad campaigns in English is a must
  • Prior experience in customer service or account management is a must
  • Technical, analytical, detail-oriented, diligent, proactive, organized, accountable, and highly motivated team player
  • Experience with eCommerce Google & Facebook ads accounts is a must

Daily tasks include

  • Manage campaigns in Google, Facebook, Bing, TikTok, Pinterest on behalf of our clients with specific performance-oriented targets
  • Help mapping structures that can be automated in media platforms across all channels
  • Communication & support with strategic clients
  • Explore additional performance-oriented channels for our clients

Our offices are located in Ramat-Hasharon and we work in a Hybrid manner (partially there and partially remotely). If you meet all the requirements or you've done something that will blow our minds, please send us your CV to: jobs@storeya.com

About StoreYa

StoreYa's marketing platform offers the only fully autonomous, performance-based advertising AI solution for eCommerce. Founded in 2012, we currently serve over 500,000 online sellers, entrepreneurs, and innovators, just like you.

Created by former eCommerce owners and expert PPC managers, our founding team understands the day-to-day struggles that you face. This first-hand knowledge of these common difficulties — such as lack of workforce, budget, and resources — led to the development and launch of StoreYa.

Ultimately, we're here to help online sellers like you scale and succeed, offering a host of free and paid eCommerce marketing tools.

Our most popular tool is Traffic Booster.

We created Traffic Booster to manage Google, Facebook, Instagram, and Microsoft Ads and optimize these campaigns in real-time. And as Google and Facebook partners, we were vetted by PayPal for two years and chosen to be PayPal's sole solution for its merchants at its app center.
